result.topic_en: Euler argues that fluid particles moving along tube walls experience friction obeying laws like those for solid bodies, with friction proportional to the pressure against the walls, and begins setting up the flow of water through a tube ABCD.

6. In corporibus autem solidis obseruamus, frictio-
nem, quam in incessu super superficie quacunque pa-
tiuntur, semper datam tenere proportionem ad vim,
qua ea ad superficiem apprimuntur, ita vt neque cor-
porum figura, neque quantitas basis, qua superficiem at-
tingunt, nihil ad frictionem, siue augendam, siue dimi-
nuendam, conferat. Ita experimentis compertum est,
si corpora quaeuis super ligneis, seu metallicis, superficie-
bus incedant, dummodo non satis notabilis asperitas
adsit, frictionem quartae ac subinde tertiae parti vis,
qua ad has superficies apprimuntur, aequari.
7. Manifestum ergo videtur, in fluidis similem
frictionis legem subsistere, ita, vt pro quauis fluidi por-
tione frictio certam quandam teneat rationem, ad vim,
qua ea fluidi portio ad latera tubi, per quem fluit,
apprimitur: haecque ratio per experimenta erit ex-
ploranda, quae forsan varias subire poterit mutationes,
prout tubi ex alia atque alia materia fuerint confecti.
In calculo ergo hanc rationem indefinite assumi con-
ueniet, vt ea postmodum ex experimentis, ad quae
Theoria applicabitur, definiri possit.

items.quote:
leges huius frictionis similes plane erunt earum, quae
in motu corporum solidorum obseruantur
items.english: The laws of this friction will be entirely similar to those observed in the motion of solid bodies.

items.quote:
Manifestum ergo videtur, in fluidis similem
frictionis legem subsistere, ita, vt pro quauis fluidi por-
tione frictio certam quandam teneat rationem, ad vim,
qua ea fluidi portio ad latera tubi, per quem fluit,
apprimitur
items.english: It therefore seems evident that a similar law of friction holds in fluids, so that for any portion of fluid the friction bears a certain ratio to the force with which that portion is pressed against the sides of the tube through which it flows.

items.quote:
haecque ratio per experimenta erit ex-
ploranda
items.english: This ratio must be explored by experiments.

items.quote:
In calculo ergo hanc rationem indefinite assumi con-
ueniet, vt ea postmodum ex experimentis, ad quae
Theoria applicabitur, definiri possit.
items.english: In the calculation it will therefore be convenient to take this ratio as indefinite, so that it can afterwards be determined from the experiments to which the theory will be applied.
